text: ἡ Κοάλα τίθησι τὸν σάκκον ἐπὶ τὴν τράπεζαν καὶ καθίζει ἐπὶ τὴν καθέδραν παρὰ τὴν γλαῦκα.
objects: a small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child
artist_notes: Koala is sitting in the chair. Koala does not wear a backpack.
positioning: Koala sits in the chair at the table.
Glaux perches on the edge of the table, watching Koala with friendly amber eyes.
The small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child sits on the tabletop at center.
